name: strikeout_tag_home_2000
description: Runners on first and third, one out. Sanchez strikes out; Ortiz is retired at the plate, catcher to pitcher. The batter was out on strikes and never became a runner, so the out at home is a TAG, not a force -- despite an event string almost identical to the 2026 Tigers force play.

source.note: Detroit at Kansas City, 2000-09-27, Kauffman Stadium, Royals 3rd
source.status: verified against the released event file

notes: UncaughtThirdStrike is forbidden even though the catcher throwing to a covering pitcher all but requires the ball got away: no WP, PB or error is charged, so the event string carries no trace of it (spec/04-ONTOLOGY.md 3.1.1).
DoublePlay is forbidden because /NDP suppresses it, despite two outs being recorded on the play.
